data.name: Pileus Bad Trip
data.detailed_description:
Saving your brother isn't just a lazy plot hook!

Pileus Bad Trip - is a hardcore action-platformer where you dive into thrilling 2D battles featuring an engaging plot, diverse locations, and tons of black humor packed with references to pop culture and cult games!

Take on the role of a surviving village mushroom and try to fix what went down while you were snoozing! That is, of course, providing YOU can even make it through the tutorial... Study your enemies' behavior and play dirty tricks on them—all for the sake of survival, naturally! Otherwise, be prepared to end up back home faster than you can say "pollen."

Features

  • A main story campaign spanning 3-4 hours about saving the mycelium network from an unknown disease.

  • Elaborate side missions and plenty of randomly generated quests.

  • Interactive environments: Smash crates, drop platforms on enemies, and don't let the infected regenerate in the undergrowth.

  • Settlement development system: Rebuild your destroyed village to regain access to the benefits of mushroom civilization—merchants, medicine, and character upgrades.

Play at your own pace: It is up to YOU to decide whether to explore every hidden nook or rush to the end, sweeping everything from your path.

What Awaits You

  • 42 Locations: 32 combat zones, 5 peaceful hubs for resting, and 5 procedurally generated levels for resource farming.

  • 19 Enemy Types: Prepare to face slugs, infected creatures, dangerous thugs, and more.

  • 4 Bosses: Fight the henchmen of the evil manipulator and eliminate the mastermind himself for the greater good.

  • Lore & Secrets: Tons of notes to help you learn more about the world of the Mushroom Kingdom.

  • Combat Pets: Buy companions with unique combat skills from Champignexson.

Status Effect System

A system of negative effects (debuffs) that impacts not just the player, but the environment and enemies as well.

Wide Arsenal of Weapons

Skill Selection: Choose the skill that best suits your playstyle

Customization: The ability to choose the perfect outfit for your hero

3 Biomes: Explore the outskirts of Gribovets City, dark dungeons, and dense forests

100+ NPCs with hundreds of unique lines of dialogue
